# Earlisthenic Community Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment
Earlisthenic is an open, welcoming community for sound engineers, producers, audio researchers, and software developers. We are committed to providing a respectful, harassment-free environment for everyone, regardless of experience level, background, identity, or setup.

## Community Guidelines
- **Be respectful and constructive:** Focus on constructive acoustic and technical discussions.
- **Graceful collaboration:** Welcome diverse perspectives on audio engineering, DSP design, and listening techniques.
- **Focus on the community:** Prioritize collaborative learning and high-fidelity sound training over gatekeeping.

## Enforcement & Reporting
Community leaders are responsible for clarifying standards of acceptable behavior and taking appropriate and fair corrective action in response to any unacceptable behavior.

To report concerns, contact the project maintainers privately at `4wards.music@gmail.com`.
